d: Bihar ki mahilaon dvara sindur lagane ki paranpra aur Chhath Puja ko lekar staind-ap komediyan Yash Maheshwari ki tippaniyon par vivad barh gaya hai. LJP (Ram Vilas) ki pradesh mahila pravakta Sonam Paswan ne is par kari narajgi jataee hai. unhonne kaha ki komedi aur vyuj barhane ke lie bihar ki mahilaon ke bare men aapattijnak shabdon ka istemal karna behad dukhad hai.
